verse.verse_1: I swear by the Day of Resurrection.
verse.verse_2: And I swear by the self-reproaching soul.
verse.verse_3: Deemest man that We shall not assemble his bones?
verse.verse_4: Yea! WE are Able to put together evenly his finger-tips.
verse.verse_5: Aye! man desireth that he may sin before him.
verse.verse_6: He asketh: when will the Day of Resurrection be?
verse.verse_7: When, then, the sight shall be confounded.
verse.verse_8: And the moon shall be ecliped.
verse.verse_9: And the sun and the moon shall be joined.
verse.verse_10: On that Day shall man say: whither is the fleeing.
verse.verse_12: Unto thy Lord that Day is the recourse.
verse.verse_13: To man will be declared on that Day that which he hath sent on and left behind.
verse.verse_14: Aye! man against himself shall be an enlightenment.
verse.verse_15: Although he may put forth his pleas.
verse.verse_16: Move not thy tongue therewith that thou mayest hasten therewith.
verse.verse_17: Verily upon us is the collecting thereof and the reciting thereof.
verse.verse_18: Wherefore when We reciteit, follow thou the reciting thereof.
verse.verse_19: And thereafter verily upon us is is the expounding thereof.
verse.verse_20: By no means! Verily ye love the Herein.
verse.verse_22: Countenances on that Day shall be resplendent,
verse.verse_24: And countenances on that Day shall be scowling.
verse.verse_25: Imagining that there will befall them a waiste-breaking calomity.
verse.verse_26: By no means! When it cometh up to he collar-bone.
verse.verse_27: And it is cried. who can charm?
verse.verse_28: And he bethinketh that it is the time of parting.
verse.verse_29: And one shank is entangled with the other shank.
verse.verse_30: Unto thy Lord that Day is the drive.
verse.verse_32: But he belied and turned away.
verse.verse_33: Then he departed Unto his house hold conceitedly.
verse.verse_36: Deemest man that he is to be left uncontrolled?
verse.verse_37: Was he not a sperm of emission emitted?
verse.verse_38: Then he became a clot; then He created him and formed him.
verse.verse_39: And made of him the two sexes, male and female.
verse.verse_40: Is not That One then Able to quicken the dead?
